description.zh: 两个地域之间的跨地域互通带宽。单位：Mbps。
description.en: The maximum bandwidth value of the inter-region connection. Unit: Mbit/s.

description.zh:
带宽的分配方式。取值：

- **BandwidthPackage**（默认值）：从带宽包中分配带宽。
description.en:
The bandwidth allocation method. Valid values:

**BandwidthPackage**: allocates bandwidth from a bandwidth plan.
The ID of the CEN instance.

description.zh:
本端地域ID。

您可以调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取云企业网支持加载的网络实例的地域信息。
description.en:
The ID of the local region.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query regions where you can attach network instances to a CEN instance.
The ID of the peer region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn set-cen-inter-region-bandwidth-limit --cen-id cen-7qthudw0ll6jmx0000 --local-region-id cn-hangzhou --opposite-region-id us-west-1 --bandwidth-limit 8 --bandwidth-type BandwidthPackage --region cn-hangzhou
